meaning: Sets the internal jugular vein baseline cross-sectional area (A_baseline_ijvs_v) to 1.2 in the Model_3 parameter deck. With A0_ijvs_v = 0.3 on line 169 it fixes where the IJV tube law sits between collapsed and distended, so it sets the vein's reference conductance and how much collapse a given external or abdominal pressure produces.

could_move.what: IJV tube-law behaviour wherever this parameter enters the Model_3 equations
Jugular compression comparisons against patient data, which hinge on how far the IJV collapses
Bistability results, since the collapsible-vein tube law is what creates multiple states
External-pressure sweeps that push the vein through its collapse range

expectation: Unknown in sign and size from this context. A larger baseline area generally means a wider, more conductive vein needing more pressure to collapse; a smaller one collapses sooner. Whether the bistable branches survive a change here cannot be told without running a case.

check.why: One Model_3 bistability case that exercises the IJV tube law and emits a plot, so collapse behaviour and branch structure can be inspected without a full re-fit.
